title: Controllers and operators: automating operations in code

videos.script: Lesson 43 left a Backup object in the cluster that nothing acted on. A controller is the program that acts. {{acts}} Every controller in Kubernetes runs the same loop. Read what is wanted. Read what exists. If they differ, change what exists. Then do it again. {{loop}} The Deployment controller does this for ReplicaSets, and the ReplicaSet controller does it for pods. Yours will do it for Backups. {{yours}} You will read a controller of ninety lines, run it against the cluster, and watch it create, update and repair a CronJob. Then it steps aside when the Backup is deleted. An operator is this idea taken far enough to run a whole database. {{operator}}
